title: Phishing Tactic Identification
question: An employee receives an urgent email from 'support@paypa1-security.com' claiming their account will be suspended within 1 hour unless they verify their password. Which two attack techniques are primarily being demonstrated?
options: Typosquatting (Look-alike domain) and Pretexting with artificial urgency
Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) and ARP Poisoning
SQL Injection and Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
Zero-day privilege escalation and Buffer Overflow
explanation: The domain 'paypa1' uses the digit 1 instead of the letter 'l' (typosquatting), and the 1-hour deadline creates artificial urgency to bypass critical thinking.

title: Authentication Factor Types
question: In Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), which of the following represents 'Something You Are' (Inherence factor)?
options: A 6-digit SMS one-time passcode (OTP)
A hardware FIDO2 USB security key
A biometric fingerprint or facial recognition scan
A 16-character alphanumeric master password
explanation: Biometrics (fingerprints, retina, face scans) represent 'something you are'. Passwords are 'something you know', and hardware keys/phones are 'something you have'.

title: Ransomware Defense
question: Which of the following backup strategies is considered the gold standard for surviving a destructive ransomware outbreak?
options: Syncing files to a single shared network folder (SMB) with write access
The 3-2-1 Rule: 3 copies, on 2 different media types, with at least 1 copy stored offline or immutable
Relying solely on external hard drives continuously plugged into workstations
Creating weekly snapshots on the same primary virtual machine host
explanation: The 3-2-1 backup strategy ensures at least one immutable or offline/air-gapped copy exists that ransomware cannot encrypt or delete over the network.

title: Denial of Service Mechanisms
question: A Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attack utilizing thousands of compromised IoT smart cameras and routers coordinated by a Command & Control (C2) server is operating as a:
options: Botnet
Honeypot
Reverse Proxy
Air Gap
explanation: A network of malware-infected devices controlled remotely by an attacker is called a botnet (such as the infamous Mirai botnet).
